settings.title: Coach Style
settings.hint: Pick your personal coach — feedback wording changes with coach style

strict-math.best: Optimal decision. EV loss 0 BB, GTO-approved frequency.
strict-math.correct: Reasonable decision. EV loss {evLoss} BB, within acceptable range.
strict-math.inaccuracy: Not precise. EV loss {evLoss} BB, optimal action is {correctAction}.
strict-math.wrong: Wrong decision. EV loss {evLoss} BB, should choose {correctAction}. Consider reviewing related lessons.
strict-math.blunder: Major mistake. EV loss {evLoss} BB, this will lead to significant losses long-term. Optimal action is {correctAction}.

old-school.best: Beautiful! That's textbook play right there.
old-school.correct: Not bad, kid. This decision makes money.
old-school.inaccuracy: Mediocre. I've played 20 years, and I'm telling you - you should {correctAction} here.
old-school.wrong: Eh, that was a rough play. Lost {evLoss} BB, should've {correctAction}. Go practice more.
old-school.blunder: Son, that's a big mistake! {evLoss} BB lost - in a real game, the sharks would eat you alive. Remember, in this spot you {correctAction}.

encouraging.best: Amazing! You're better than 80% of players!
encouraging.correct: Great! This decision is reasonable, keep it up!
encouraging.inaccuracy: So close! The optimal action is {correctAction}, try it next time.
encouraging.wrong: No worries, every expert started here. EV loss {evLoss} BB, optimal is {correctAction}. You got this!
encouraging.blunder: Don't lose heart! Lost {evLoss} BB this time, but it's a valuable learning opportunity. Remember {correctAction}, you'll nail it next time!
